program_name: Decision And Behavior Minor Undergraduate Program
text: The required courses pool for the Decision And Behavior Minor Undergraduate Program (DECB-MINOR), admit/curriculum term Fall 2025-2026 (202501) contains 2 courses; minimum 6 SU credits required; minimum 2 courses required. Courses: ECON 201 Games and Strategies, PSY 201 Mind and Behavior.

program_name: Decision And Behavior Minor Undergraduate Program
text: The core electives pool for the Decision And Behavior Minor Undergraduate Program (DECB-MINOR), admit/curriculum term Fall 2025-2026 (202501) contains 17 courses; minimum 12 SU credits required; minimum 4 courses required. Courses: CONF 300 Conflict Analysis and Resolution, CS 404 Artificial Intelligence, CS 412 Machine Learning, ECON 312 Behavioral Economics, ECON 495 Machine Learning for Policy Evaluation, IE 405 Decision Analysis, MGMT 414 Negotiation Skills, MKTG 301 Introduction to Marketing, MKTG 402 Consumer Behavior, ORG 302 Organizational Behavior, PHIL 310 Philosophy of Mind, POLS 404 Comparative Party Systems and Electoral Behavior, PSY 310 Cognitive Processes, PSY 340 Social Psychology, PSY 341 Applied Social Psychology, PSY 344 Group Processes, PSY 350 Introduction to Neuroscience. At least 4 courses (12 SU credits) must be completed. This 4 courses must be distributed over at least 3 out of 5 categories. For example, a student can take one PSY (Category 1), one POLS (Category 2), and one ECON (Category 3) course from the pool below. They will be counted as 3 elective courses. Nevertheless, one PSY (Category 1), one PHIL (Category 2), and one POLS (Category 2) course will be counted as 2 elective courses (rather than 3), because PHIL and POLS codes are in the same category based on the table below. -Category 1: PSY coded courses listed in the pool below. -Category 2: CONF, PHIL, POLS coded courses listed in the pool below. -Category 3: ECON coded courses listed in the pool below. -Category 4: CS, IE coded courses listed in the pool below. -Category 5: MKTG, MGMT, ORG coded courses listed in the pool below.
